components.observed_truth: Production-deployed static browser application with broad local-first surfaces and a reserved API origin.
FA-06 through FA-20 implementation, evidence, release-control, and runtime-connection assets; several surfaces remain preview/control-plane oriented.

components.location: protected deployed runtime plus ops adapters
components.observed_truth: Certified 74-operation quantitative execution plane behind the protected runtime.
Request/SSE-bound task transport can perform fixed-source research and route at most one quantitative operation per objective.
Large development capability fabric with 110 mapped targets, 18 submission skills, 12 frontier skills, tests, gates, and runtime modules.
Separate MCP-facing integration surface exists but is not the canonical browser task pipeline.

components.location: docs/axiom_final_product, workflows, and vNext verifier modules
components.observed_truth: Strong phase-specific fail-closed evidence patterns exist, but they do not prove product-wide runtime integration.

connections.evidence: The authoritative project substrate is browser-local IndexedDB and does not claim cloud or multi-device sync.
connections.required_resolution: Versioned server Project/Work Graph contracts plus offline synchronization and conflict policy.

connections.evidence: The runtime candidate is request/SSE-bound and has no queue, workflow engine, or Durable Object execution ownership.
connections.required_resolution: Persist task and step state before execution, lease work, checkpoint every transition, and resume idempotently.

connections.evidence: The live task service does not import or dispatch the Frontier V5 fabric/runtime capability router.
connections.required_resolution: A versioned capability adapter registry with qualification state, policy scope, cost, and receipt bindings.

connections.evidence: Transport and 74-operation discovery exist, but each objective routes to at most one quantitative operation and is not a general multi-tool plan.
connections.required_resolution: Expose V3 operations as typed tools in the governed fabric and allow policy-bounded multi-step composition.

connections.evidence: No canonical qualified model router owns planning, fallback, budget, and evidence for the full task path.
connections.required_resolution: Provider-neutral plan contract with a zero/low-cost default route, optional paid providers, and deterministic fallback.

connections.evidence: Phase-specific approval logic exists, but a single enforceable side-effect boundary is not shared by every tool and plane.
connections.required_resolution: Central policy decision and approval token bound to actor, project, task, step, tool, arguments digest, expiry, and risk.

connections.evidence: Strong specialized evidence modules exist, but no mandatory product-wide step receipt links plans, calls, outputs, artifacts, approvals, and retries.
connections.required_resolution: Append-only, hash-linked receipts for every step and artifact with redaction and replay boundaries.

connections.evidence: The runtime connection workflow binds staging/canary to the production D1 database.
connections.required_resolution: Dedicated staging and canary databases populated only with synthetic or explicitly scrubbed fixtures.

connections.evidence: The user can see broad surfaces, but a general prompt is not proven to create a durable plan, call multiple qualified tools, survive interruption, and return a sealed artifact.
connections.required_resolution: One canonical Task API and event stream used by every supported surface, backed by the durable orchestrator.

critical_risks.condition: A successful narrow transport test is presented as full product connection.
critical_risks.control: Require the full-connection acceptance trace defined by AR-01.

critical_risks.condition: Recovery rewrites replace Frontier V5 or Phase 1–15 assets without an equivalence map.
critical_risks.control: No-delete preservation matrix and contract adapters before replacement.

critical_risks.condition: Non-production runtimes continue to use production D1.
critical_risks.control: Environment-isolated data bindings are a precondition for execution work.

critical_risks.condition: Request termination, deploy, or disconnect loses plan/step state.
critical_risks.control: Durable state transitions, leases, idempotency, checkpoint, retry, and dead-letter handling.

critical_risks.condition: A paid key is required for the only usable plan route.
critical_risks.control: Credential-free deterministic tools and a zero/low-cost model route remain first-class.
